answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 36165 Country: India Title: What is the current percentage of zakah on the income? Question: What is the current percentage of zakah on the income? Answer ID: 36165 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 98/52/L=1433) The current percentage of zakah is 2.5% i.e. 2 rupees and 50 paise out of one hundred rupees. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
